question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **fictions**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**fictions**" refers to imaginary stories or literature. (काल्पनिक कहानियाँ या साहित्य)
 
• It is a noun in plural form.
 
 
• **For example**: *I enjoy reading science fiction novels that take me to imaginative worlds.*
 
 
 
• In the sentence provided, the term "**fictions**" aligns with the idea of imaginative stories or narratives.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
